title: PIIConsent
description: Formal consent record authorizing PII sharing with specific platforms. Built by the frontend when the user confirms which fields to share and with which lenders.

fields_consented.description: Exact PII field names the user authorized for sharing.

platform_ids.description: Lender platform IDs authorized to receive PII.

consented_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when consent was given.
